meta.title: Business partnership management and contribution-based profit split | 1lev1
meta.description: Fifty-fifty is not fairness, it is giving up on the arithmetic. Here is how to measure what each partner actually gave - in time, money and equipment - and derive the split from it. With a calculator you can run on your own numbers.

hero.h1: How to split profits between partners without arguing about fifty-fifty
hero.sub: The homepage showed you the problem and the calculator. What sits underneath them is here: why the four failures of fifty-fifty belong to the method rather than to the partners, how the calculation works step by step, and what transparency buys once it is in place.

calc.title: Now on your own numbers
calc.sub: The same calculation that runs on real rikma data. Change the hours, the investments and the sales, and watch what it does to the comparison against fifty-fifty.

doubts.title: What partnerships ask before they move their books
doubts.q1_q: We are already fifty-fifty partners. Can we switch without reopening everything?
doubts.q1_a: Yes. You can start logging from today onward without touching history - the calculation covers the period you started from. And if you want to bring the past in, you can enter it as prior contributions, provided every partner approves them.
doubts.q2_q: What about contributions that are hard to measure - contacts, reputation, the idea?
doubts.q2_a: They enter like any other contribution: someone proposes a value, and the partners either approve it or propose a different one. The system does not decide what a contact is worth - it only makes sure the number is agreed and recorded rather than an argument that returns every quarter.
doubts.q3_q: Is this legally binding on us?
doubts.q3_a: The system runs the consent and the arithmetic; it does not replace a legal agreement. Many partnerships use it precisely to work out what to put in one - because for the first time there are agreed numbers to write down.

close.title: Ready to start measuring?
close.sub: You can open a rikma and invite your partners in a few minutes. Logging starts with the next hour, not the next month.
